name: Nol
source:
While she looks like a child, she is an elder elf and the oldest (also leader) of the elf clan.
With the help of ancient documents of the great elders she summons the protagonist to her world.

[spoiler]184014 years old.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Her true name is Norn Alfheim.[/spoiler]
